metricText: Monthly Old Age Pension (Tandabala Allowance) amount per beneficiary printed in Botswana's national budget for a fixed financial year and effective date.
note: PROPOSED: The official 2025 Budget Speech prints an increase from P830.00 to P1400.00 effective 2025-04-01, but admission requires a new bw-budget-print parser and authenticated release-time capture custody. The official UDC 2024 manifesto PDF prints a P1,800 monthly promise; the plan-named dumaboko.com campaign page instead prints P1,500 from a P530 baseline, so it is retained as a disclosed party-source discrepancy rather than used to rewrite the 2024 promise. bw-udc-pension-promise is a reserved future bills/ slug; no such entry exists yet. BWP may need an entry in the site Unit union at registration time.
statisticalProduct: Annual Budget Speech, Old Age Pension (Tandabala Allowance) monthly amount

verification.reason: The official 2025 Budget Speech contains one unambiguous monthly Old Age Pension amount and effective date, corroborated by an official DailyNews announcement. This is a new adapter family, and the post-release fetch does not authenticate first-print bytes or establish a recurring capture contract.

artifact.title: 2025 BUDGET SPEECH
artifact.printedSentence: With this in mind, we propose an increase of the Old Age Pension (Tandabala Allowance) from P830.00 to P1400.00 effective 1st April 2025.

officialServicePageArtifact.sourceClassification: Official Government of Botswana service page; its captured amount conflicts with the later official 2025 Budget Speech and is therefore contextual rather than the resolving print.
officialServicePageArtifact.printedSentence: Currently, the pension allowance is BWP830.00 per month.
officialServicePageArtifact.freshnessNote: The captured page provides no update date and still prints the pre-budget amount.

announcementArtifact.sourceClassification: Official Government of Botswana DailyNews article sourced and authored by BOPA; announcement evidence, not the recurring budget resolution product.
announcementArtifact.articleTitle: Old Age Pension increases to 1 400 effective April
announcementArtifact.printedEffectiveSentence: The long wait for Old Age Pension increase by government will be realised effective April 1.
announcementArtifact.printedAmountSentence: Although government had promised an increase it from P830 to P1 800, the Old Age pensioners will instead receive P1 400 as their monthly allowance.

promiseArtifact.sourceClassification: Primary 2024 manifesto PDF hosted by the Umbrella for Democratic Change party; partisan promise evidence, not an official government observation.
promiseArtifact.title: UDC MANIFESTO FOR 2024 BOTSWANA ELECTIONS short
promiseArtifact.heading: Summary of UDC Government Commitments
promiseArtifact.printedSentence: Reduce the old age pension eligibility from 65 to 60 years and increase the pension allowance from P830 to P1,800 per month.

planNamedPartyPageArtifact.sourceClassification: Duma Boko campaign page; a partisan source, not a government publication.
planNamedPartyPageArtifact.heading: Old age pension
planNamedPartyPageArtifact.printedSentence: The old age pension is a paltry P530 per month, which sadly denies our senior citizens dignity. We will increase the old age pension to P1500 per month to help seniors afford the basics for subsistence. After all many of them are responsible for raising their grandchildren.
planNamedPartyPageArtifact.discrepancy: This fetched page does not print P1,800. The separate official UDC 2024 manifesto PDF above is the captured party source for the P1,800 promise.

accountabilityTarget.question: Does a future budget print reach P1,800?
accountabilityTarget.thresholdSemantics: The fixed future official budget print must state a monthly Old Age Pension amount of at least BWP 1,800.
accountabilityTarget.promiseBasis: The captured UDC 2024 manifesto PDF, page 4.
accountabilityTarget.registrationBlocker: A future registration must specify the target financial year or deadline and bind an exact official Ministry of Finance budget release and capture window; the party promise cannot resolve the outcome.

firstPrint.blocker: A post-release fetch of the report-specific 2025 Budget Speech PDF does not prove its release-time first print or preserve later replacement bytes under authenticated custody.

requiredWork: Implement and review a bw-budget-print parser that discovers the fixed financial year's speech from the official Budget Speech listing, validates title and financial year, and extracts the Old Age Pension monthly amount and effective date from one named paragraph.
Add release-time witnessed or versioned capture custody before admission, with genuine annual-edition pins that test title, paragraph, amount, effective-date, amendment, and replacement handling.
Keep the gov.bw service page, DailyNews announcement, and party manifesto as cross-check or promise context only; none may substitute for the registered official budget print.
parseNotes: Treat the series as annual and budget-driven: key observations by the fixed financial year and preserve the separately printed effective date.
Normalize P1400.00 to numeric BWP 1400 without changing the printed monthly basis.
Do not resolve from the stale service-page amount or infer delivery of P1,800 from a party statement; resolve only from the registered future official budget print.
BWP may need to be added to the site Unit union during later registration; that is not an ingestion-request blocker.
